notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Addition of galleries: 
- Atlas Coelestis, John Flamsteed

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- More music
- Additional images in the gallery mode
- Bug fix in the main scene
- Meteor showers of 2021

notes.title: Update - Star Sweeper
notes.content:
- Addition of the mode Star Sweeper: play the Mine Sweeper inside a spherical polyhedron. Find stars instead of mines.

- Update of the gallery mode.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: - Addition of a gallery mode (you can edit the galleries.json file and place images in the galleries folder to add any image that you wish); more pictures will come.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Addition of an introduction scene
- Control: the selection is now on the trigger (not on the A or X button)
- Update of the positions of the menus
- Update of some default settings
- New image for the "not found image" when an image is not present for a given survey

notes.title: Update (12/25/2020)
notes.content: Addition of a catalog corresponding to NASA, ESA, Hubble space telescope images. It includes 111 images from other catalogs (Messier, NGC, ...) in color.

notes.title: Small update - Meteor Showers
notes.content:
- Addition of meteor showers
- Some bug fixed with the hands

notes.title: Update (09/13/2020)
notes.content:
- Bug fix: problem when there is no image for a deep sky object in one of the surveys
- Telescope and Eyepiece panel to get information about magnification and magnitude limit
- Possibility to select an environment sound (insects in the nature) instead of the music

notes.title: Update (08/29/2020)
notes.content:
- Regeneration of all the music with volume amplification

- UI update: bounding boxes for some buttons
- Ground: size of the tiles
- Code refactoring

notes.title: Update (08/22/2020)
notes.content: - Addition of the 5386 images of the IC catalog

images: DSS2B, DSS2R, DSS2IR for the Arp catalog
images: Wise1,2,3,.4 for the Sharpless catalog

notes.title: Update (7/2/2020)
notes.content:
- UI update (icon on selected objects in the sky, to know that a deep sky object has been properly selected)

notes.title: Update (6/29/2020)
notes.content:
- Some User Interface changes
- Gound 6 is a completely black ground
- More buttons to edit the views of the images
- Update of the colors of the laser for select/unselect/clicked

Remarks:
- The complete NGC catalog is too big with its 7840 images, so it would explode the disk space.
- Other surveys (e.g. DSS2R, DSS2B) will be added soon.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update (6/21/2020):
- Additional music
- Some bugs fixed in the user interface
- Color schemes are in a JSON file (colorscheme.json), users can edit the file and create their own theme
- Additional information is provided for the Deep Sky Objects (Messier, Caldwell, and Hershell400) with the name of the discoverer and the year.

News:
- Next update will be large with the 7840 objects of the New General Catalog of Nebulae and Clusters of Stars.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:

- All the deep sky object images have been regenerated with 2 degree field of view (linear scaling for DSS, log scaling for WISE). 
- More UI color schemes for the interface
- FOV buttton (2, 1, 0.5 degree)
- Grid button for the deep sky object (circle, circle with cross)
